current.text: Rookie. Milwaukee drafted him 10th overall. He is 21 years old.
The team views him as its long-term shooting guard.

Milwaukee's guard group is crowded. Rollins, Herro, Porter, Jakucionis, Trent and Green all compete for backcourt minutes. He is not in the projected opening starting five of Rollins, Herro, Jaquez, Kuzma and Turner.
He has no clear path to minutes. Experts do not expect 30 minutes right away and think he may need until year three to be useful in fantasy.
A rank around 240 is reasonable. His ADP of 113 is too high.
Do not draft him in standard leagues. He is a stash option only in stash formats.
He may get chances in March. The Bucks are expected to focus more on young players as the season goes on, which would cut veteran minutes.
Taylor Jenkins is the new head coach. He might use a deep rotation.
The Bucks roster needs trades to consolidate, and more moves are possible. That could change the guard minutes.
Experts expect the Bucks to be a bad team. Their win total is 26.5. They do not own their draft pick, so they have no reason to tank.

durable.text: He is a combo guard without a classic fantasy skill set. He has a flat stat profile with no standout category and is not a big source of steals, blocks or assists.
In summer league he averaged about 19 points, 4 rebounds, 3.5 assists, 1.8 threes and 1.6 steals. He shot poorly from the free throw line.
His best case is about 80% of Bradley Beal: scoring, decent threes and okay rebounds and assists.

note: Yahoo ranks him 242 and ESPN 226, both value him at 0 USD, and our league drafts only 144 players, so do not spend auction money on him. The sites cannot agree on what kind of guard he is (Yahoo projects 1.3 threes and 2.4 assists, ESPN 0.4 threes and 4.1 assists), and no category stands out in his profile, so he helps no particular build. Leave him on waivers and check the Bucks guard minutes after the trade deadline (2027-03-04). If Milwaukee shifts minutes to young players, he could be a short-term pickup for the playoff weeks in March.
